svg.title: ZeroTrace
svg.desc: App icon: ZT drawn at Inter's cap-height ratio on an approved dark surface. Corner radius follows the logo sheet's 0.219 app-icon ratio. Mono variant, since the sheet forces full density below 13px and a favicon never exceeds it. Letterforms are drawn rather than set, because Inter is rarely installed and a text element would fall back to a face the sheet forbids. A flagged stand-in until the real outlined favicon file exists.
